# Best waterproof Bluetooth speakers for the pool or beach

**Best overall: JBL Charge 6** (about $130-$150)
- It has an IP68 rating, 20 hours of battery (28 with Playtime Boost), and strong, clear sound. It can also charge your phone.
- What Hi-Fi? named it best overall, and BestProducts and iTechGuides picked it too.
- Prices: $129.99 at Walmart, $149.95 at Amazon, $159.95 at Best Buy.
- Buy links: [What Hi-Fi? list](https://www.whathifi.com/best-buys/best-waterproof-speakers-around-right-now-budget-portable-smart) or [BestProducts](https://www.bestproducts.com/tech/gadgets/g938/best-waterproof-bluetooth-speakers/)

**Best budget: Ultimate Ears Wonderboom 4** (about $65-$80)
- It's rated IP67, floats, and has 360-degree sound. Battery life is about 14 hours.
- It's small, so it won't get as loud or bassy as bigger models.
- Buy links: [BestProducts](https://www.bestproducts.com/tech/gadgets/g938/best-waterproof-bluetooth-speakers/) or [RTINGS](https://www.rtings.com/speaker/reviews/best/by-type/waterproof-bluetooth)

**Best for sound that reaches everyone: Ultimate Ears Epicboom**
- Tom's Guide ranks it best overall, and RTINGS ranks it best mid-range. It's IP67, floats, and has 360-degree sound, so it sounds the same wherever you sit.
- Battery life is about 15 hours. I don't have a price from these results.
- Buy links: [Tom's Guide](https://www.tomsguide.com/best-picks/best-waterproof-speakers) or [RTINGS](https://www.rtings.com/speaker/reviews/best/by-type/waterproof-bluetooth)

**Best for big parties: JBL Boombox 4**
- RTINGS' top pick. It can be immersed for long periods, floats, gets loud, and lasts over 40 hours. It's big and pricey, and the sound is directional.
- Buy link: [RTINGS](https://www.rtings.com/speaker/reviews/best/by-type/waterproof-bluetooth)

**Best pocket-size: JBL Go 5** (about $40)
- It's IP67 with up to 8 hours of battery (10 with Playtime Boost). It's tiny and surprisingly good, but it won't fill a big space.
- Buy link: [What Hi-Fi?](https://www.whathifi.com/best-buys/best-waterproof-speakers-around-right-now-budget-portable-smart)

**Loud floating option: Soundcore Boom 2 Plus**
- It puts out 100 W, is IPX7, floats, and lasts up to 20 hours at half volume with lights off. It weighs 3.8 kg (about 8.4 lb), so it's heavy.
- It lists at $249.99. Code AFSC20 takes it to about $200, per the Dealectric listing, which says it tested the code in Soundcore's cart on Oct 22. Prices change, so check at checkout.
- [Buy at Soundcore](https://dealectric.com/go/soundcore-boom-2-plus). This is an affiliate link, so Dealectric earns a commission.

## Tips
- Look for IP67 or IP68 for pool or beach use. Sand and dust matter too, so the first digit should be 5 or 6 ([Good Housekeeping](https://www.goodhousekeeping.com/what-to-buy/a71783745/best-waterproof-speakers/)).
- IP ratings don't cover salt or chlorine damage. Rinse the speaker with fresh water after use if the manufacturer allows it, and dry it before charging ([RTINGS](https://www.rtings.com/speaker/reviews/best/by-type/waterproof-bluetooth)).
- Keep the charging-port flap closed. At the beach, set the speaker on a towel rather than in the sand.

**My pick:** the JBL Charge 6 for most people. If you mostly want something small to toss in the pool, the Wonderboom 4 is the better value.
